item.text:
Verified the cited constants: `ProtocolVersionMin = 0`, `ProtocolVersionMax = 3` (config.go), so for a default v3 node `checkRPCHeader` admits header versions 2..3 — matching the report's reachability claim. Report and artifacts remain consistent.

This turn was a consolidation/verification pass:

- Confirmed the protocol-version gate analysis behind F1/F2/F3 remote reachability (sender-chosen header `ProtocolVersion` in 2..3 passes; no auth/membership check).
- Reviewed `snapshot.go` `shouldSnapshot`/`takeSnapshot` (records the *committed* configuration and enforces `snapReq.index >= committedIndex`), `peersjson.go` `ReadPeersJSON`/`ReadConfigJSON` (return errors, no panic), and the `LogCache`/`util.go` helpers — all consistent with the released implementation.
- Refreshed the one-command reproduction (`audit/run_all.log`) so it reflects the current 7-case battery and leadership-transfer consistency stress; every step behaves as documented (3 panics + 4 graceful controls; direct + end-to-end F1; benign-flake/durability/consistency pass; expected F1 process abort).
- Recorded run-to-run variance in the consistency counters rather than quoting a fixed number.

Standing result: three concrete, reproducible defects — F1 (`InstallSnapshot.Configuration`), F2 (unknown `LogType`), F3 (`LogConfiguration.Data`) — form one localized class of RPC-reachable, unauthenticated, remote-crash defects (no `recover()` in the RPC main loop; analogous control paths handle malformed input gracefully). All are inherited from upstream `hashicorp/raft@v1.7.3`, whose tree is byte-identical to the release, so nothing is claimed as injected. Negative/benign evidence otherwise, with honest executed-vs-source distinctions throughout.

Report: [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-09_08-06-10-hashicorp_raft-baseline/work/report.md); evidence reproducible with `bash audit/run_all.sh`. Remaining gaps: the ~15 TCP/loopback test groups require the private-loopback `isolated_exec`, and `fuzzy/`/`raft-compat/` have no offline reference or runnable dependencies.
